'''Carnivorous snails''' were predatory [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusks]] native to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. They preyed upon those [[Fabool/Legends|fabools]] which were impaled upon [[Blba tree/Legends|blba trees]]. They grew to approximately the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] hand. [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] was bitten by several such snails during her sojourn on Dantooine.
